messages:
sara_sales: FYI — prospect Foxglove is asking if we can onboard a custom adapter (they call it foxglove-clip-70b) into our catalog for a POC. They want SOW ballpark, security questionnaire answers, and a compatibility check for dedicated/private deploy in eu-west-1. Can SEs weigh in?

mike_se: 👍 pinging @raj_engineer and @anya_sre. Quick q: do they already have model artifacts (hf/ggml/torchscript) or only a Docker runtime? That determines our adapter path.

sara_sales: They have a Torch checkpoint + tokenizer files and a small adapter recipe. No Triton bundle. Also asked about quantized variants (8-bit) and KV cache for chat use.

raj_engineer: Good — Torch checkpoint is fine. Two quick notes: 1) For a 70B dense model we recommend a quantized 8-bit int8/q4_0 variant for Dedicated/Private to hit cost targets. 2) KV cache support depends on model concat/kv layout; I’ll run a variant scan but likely fine if it's standard transformer. Expected memory: ~260GB GPU for fp16 70B, ~90–110GB for int8 + offload depending on sharding.

mike_se: Can you run a compatibility checklist? I care about these items: tokenizer mapping (BPE vs SentencePiece), special tokens, kv cache layout, attention implementation (rope vs rotary), layernorm variant (rmsnorm vs layernorm). If any mismatch we may need a small shim.

raj_engineer: On it. Ask them to upload a tiny sample: config.json + tokenizer.json + first two layers of checkpoint (for us to inspect). Also helpful: a few prompt examples and expected latency SLO (p99 per-token).

anya_sre: From infra/sre: private deploy in eu-west-1 is fine but callout: KMS/HSM integration for keys will add ~2w to timeline if they require dedicated HSM. Also need their IP allowlist + VPN details for air-gapped routing. Audit log retention requirements?

luis_soleng: For SOW pricing: range depends on expected RPS and commit. Quick estimate: POC (4–6 weeks, single dedicated node, engineering support) around $35k–$55k. If they need reserved capacity + private control plane + KMS, add $50–120k depending on HSM and retention. I need RPS and monthly token estimates to refine.

sara_sales: They said 20 QPS peak, avg 5 QPS, and bursty usage with ~12M tokens/month in POC. They want to hit 150ms per-token p50.

raj_engineer: 150ms p50 for a 70B on a single A100-ish is ambitious but possible with quantization and batching. We'll aim for p50 ~120–200ms depending on sequence length; p99 will be higher. Recommend config:

```
model_variant: foxglove-70b-q8
sharding: tensor+pipeline (2x4)
batching: dynamic, max_batch_tokens: 4096
caching: prefix KV cache enabled
quantization: q8_0 (per-channel)
opt_kernel: flash_attn/optimized-matmul
```

mike_se: +1 to the config. Also flag: if they use non-standard attention we may fallback to slower kernel. We should surface a list of model features that would cause degraded perf.

legal_bot: Sara — upload the security questionnaire here: https://rdrwd.docs/secq/foxglove-2025 or attach PDF. I’ll prefill standard sections (data residency, encryption at rest/in transit, SOC2/Audit).

sara_sales: Uploaded the questionnaire and a short prompt set. Link: https://files.redwood/foxglove/poc/pack.zip. Also cc: procurement contact (anna@foxglove.ai).

anya_sre: Noted. For private deploy, send network diagram and KMS requirements. If they want HSM-backed keys, timeline + cost adjust.

luis_soleng: I can draft a two-option SOW: (A) POC lite (shared infra + eng support) — $40k; (B) Private reserved (small cluster + KMS) — $95k. Need to confirm SLA, monitoring retention, and whether they want rollback policies.

mike_se: I'll start the compatibility scan once they drop the sample artifacts. I'll also add a short regen test suite (3 prompts + eval) to measure quality regression after quantization.

sara_sales: Great — I'll reply to Foxglove and request the sample artifacts and network diagram. Can we aim to have a preliminary tech assessment by EOD Wed?

raj_engineer: EOD Wed is doable if artifacts arrive today. Otherwise shift to end of week.

sara_sales: Thanks everyone — looping in @anna_foxglove (procurement) on next steps. Meeting to align Wednesday 10am PT? :calendar: 

anna_foxglove: (from prospect) thanks, will upload artifacts by EOD today and confirm 10am PT.

sara_sales: Perfect — will send calendar invite and draft SOW options this afternoon. :rocket:
